result.topic_en: An algebraic transformation of an equation involving quantities a, b, c, A, B, C and G (apparently related to principal axes or a characteristic cubic in G), multiplying an earlier equation by a factor and reducing it to a rational expression in G.
result.transcription:
$\alpha = \frac{1}{\sqrt{\left\{1 + \left[\frac{bc + a(G-A)}{ac + b(G-B)}\right]^2 - \left[\frac{bc + a(G-A)}{ab + c(G-C)}\right]^2\right\}}}$

Multiplicirt man die Gleichung * mit $a(bb+cc) - bc(B+C) + 2bc.G$

so erhält man nach einer leichten Verwandlung

#. $[a(bb+cc) - bc(B+C) + 2bcG].\left(1 - \frac{bc}{bc + a(G-A)}\right) = abc\left\{\frac{ab+c(G-C)}{ac+b(G-B)} + \frac{ac+b(G-B)}{ab+c(G-C)}\right\} + acc + abb$

oder

$a\left\{\frac{ab+c(G-C)}{ac+b(G-B)} + \frac{ac+b(G-B)}{ab+c(G-C)}\right\} = -(B+C) + 2G - \frac{a(bb+cc) - bc(B+C) + 2bcG}{bc + a(G-A)}$

$a\left\{\frac{ab+c(G-C)}{ac+b(G-B)} + \frac{ac+b(G-B)}{ab+c(G-C)} - \frac{[ab+c(G-C)][ac+b(G-B)]}{\{bc+a(G-A)\}^2}\right\} = -(B+C) + 2G - \ldots\ldots$

$= \frac{\left\{\begin{array}{l} abc(aa+bb+cc) - aaA(bb+cc) - bbB(aa+cc) - ccC(aa+bb) + abc(BC+AC+AB) \\ [-+ 2abc(\ldots)G-] \quad + \{2aabb + 2aacc + 2bbcc - 2abc(A+B+C)\}G + 3abc.GG \end{array}\right\}}{(bc+a(G-A))^2}$

[-$= -(B+C) + 2G - \frac{abc(G-G')(G-G'')}{\{bc+a(G-A)\}^2}$-]

$= \frac{\left\{\begin{array}{l} 2aaG^3 - (2aaA + 2aaB + 2aaC + abc)GG + \left\{\begin{array}{l}2aaA(A+B+C) - 2abcA \\ - 2aa(bb+cc)\end{array}\right\}G \\ - aaAA(B+C) + abc(AB+AC-BC) - aa(bbB+ccC) \\ \quad ([-bbA-] [-ccA-]) \\ - abc(aa+bb+cc) \end{array}\right.}{[bc + a(G-A)^2]^2}$

$= \left.\begin{array}{l} aaG(G-G')(G-G'') - abcGG + (2aaA[A+B+C] - 2abcA - 2aa(bb+cc))G \\ - aaA(AB+AC+BC) + abc(AB+AC-BC) + aaA(aa+bb+cc) \\ - abc(3aa+bb+cc) \end{array}\right\} : *$
